iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 45. RISING: US-Iran talks collapsed partly on nuclear issues. Trump: "IRAN IS UNWILLING TO GIVE UP ITS NUCLEAR AMBITIONS." Iran envoy previously said not seeking weapons-grade enrichment but talks failed on demands for full enrichment dismantlement. 440kg of 60% enriched uranium still unaccounted for. IAEA cannot verify Isfahan new site status. US claims uranium "deeply buried but under satellite surveillance." Technical: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 20%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 45 of war. CRITICAL ESCALATION: US-Iran peace talks COLLAPSED after 21 hours in Islamabad (Apr 12). Trump announces US Navy BLOCKADE of Strait of Hormuz. CENTCOM says blockade begins 14:00 GMT. Iran says Hormuz "will not be opened." VP Vance: "They have chosen not to accept our terms." Iran FM says negotiators were "inches away" but failed on Hormuz control and nuclear dismantlement. Oil surging past $110+, spot prices $141 in some regions. Trump: "It is all or nothing." China reportedly planning to help Iran with air-defense weaponry. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 48%. Rising sharply.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 45. VOLATILE: Fighting continues despite US-Iran ceasefire. Netanyahu says ceasefire does NOT cover Lebanon. Israel rammed UNIFIL vehicles. Lebanese Red Cross paramedic killed. 1,500+ killed, 1M displaced. BUT: Netanyahu authorizes direct talks with Lebanon. Pope Leo XIV urges immediate ceasefire. Israeli FM says wants "real peace agreement." Iran talks collapse removes leverage. Diplomatic: MEDIUM. Probability DOWN slightly to 28%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Nuclear infrastructure expanding. Plan to build 8 nuclear reactors. FM Fidan warns of nuclear arms race if Iran develops weapons. Roketsan 300ER missile test planned. Akkuyu commissioning. Technical: HIGH. Probability UP to 15%. Stable.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: WATCH: US think tank warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 due to "heightened terrorist activity." Pakistan Defence Minister issued statement Apr 4. Pakistan mediating Iran ceasefire simultaneously. Heightened tensions from Operation Sindoor aftermath. Rhetoric: HIGH. Probability UP to 26%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 50. STRATEGIC WINDFALL: Iran war diverting Western attention. Oil surging, sanctions easing billions into Russia. Nuclear false flag concerns (Euronews). RealClearDefense: doctrine changes for sphere of influence. GLOBSEC: hybrid warfare escalation 2026. New START expired Feb 2026. Probability stable at 57%.

china.name: China
china.notes: ESCALATING: Xi meets KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun in Beijing, talks "peace and cooperation" but says China will "absolutely not tolerate" Taiwan independence. Taiwan tracks "worrying rise" in Chinese naval activity. NBC News reports China planning to help Iran with air-defense weaponry - major geopolitical move. $222B on Eastern PLA forces. Deep-sea cable cutter operational. Technical: CRITICAL. Mobilization: HIGH. Probability UP to 22%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 45. SUSTAINED TESTING: 3 consecutive days of missile launches (Apr 7-9). Cluster-bomb warhead ballistic missiles tested. Top diplomat repeats SK is "most hostile enemy state." Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Soft signal: Kim complimented SK President Lee previously. ICBM, tactical nukes deployed. Global distraction from Iran war gives NK cover. Probability 85%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1148+. STRATEGIC WINDFALL continues: Iran war diverting Western attention, oil surging billions into Russian coffers. Medvedev threatens nuclear weapons against Ukraine and supplier countries. NATO strained by US-European rift over Iran. ISW reports Russian advances across multiple sectors. RAND report on Russia in High North escalation risks. New START expired. Hormuz blockade will further spike oil, benefiting Russia. Probability stable at 78%.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: Fighting resumed after Eid ceasefire. Urumqi talks continue but mortar incidents persist. Pakistan mediating Iran ceasefire simultaneously. Probability 12%. Stable.
